mode: Native grammar, lower_case_table_names=0, empty sql_mode, utf8mb4 connection, checked signed INT and explicit utf8mb4_bin VARCHAR columns.

ExternalRelationKind.role: The closed classification of an external MySQL read relation.
ExternalRelationKind.conditions: An external value uses the kind and absolute identity supplied by the declaration environment. Write destinations accept the base-table kind.
ExternalRelationKind.meaning: Read the referenced base relation or evaluate the referenced external view using the database declaration.
ExternalRelationKind.sql: Emit the absolute object and its controlled occurrence alias. The object already exists under the declared kind.

structure: An absolute external identity, closed relation kind and consumed typed slots. A directly re-exposed VARCHAR view field retains its declared collation, character capacity and resulting nullability.
conditions: Resolve a complete visible heading before allocating slots. Support the named external table and view identities with native signed INT or checked VARCHAR slots. Check every view write at the owning base-table boundary. Treat remote databases, expressions without a resolved VARCHAR collation and updatable-view effects as open.
meaning: A view supplies the rows from its external definition. Joins and projection use exactly that source identity and scope. Preserve statement-level view evaluation, multiplicity and NULL extension, including when the source table is updated before the read. There is no persisted snapshot in an ordinary MySQL view.
sql: Emit the absolute database and object names and quote the resolved field names. The external view owns its declared algorithm and query.
observations: Loaded relation kind, exact field slot, absolute database and object coordinates
Type, values, quoted output labels and count of duplicate rows including NULL
Same-named decoy in another database, a filtered live MERGE view and a live TEMPTABLE view
Explicit view output names and direct projected VARCHAR metadata
Separate construction rejection for writes targeting a view

finite.completeness: Recover each distinct source, placement, projection and predicate from the constructed value. Consume the 36-cell direct product on each pinned release.

analysis: Aliased view with a declared heading
Equivalent qualified and unqualified view field references
Native VARCHAR from a MERGE view
Native VARCHAR from a TEMPTABLE view
Left join with the view on the nullable side
Nested view re-exposes the previous VARCHAR declaration

exploration.requiredForms: Vary base and view sources, absolute identities, nested joins, projected names and types, missing right rows, duplicate slots and nullable predicates.

negative: View as direct INSERT SELECT destination
An analyzed UPDATE targeting a view
A VARCHAR view output without a resolved declared collation
faults: Read the plain source table instead of a filtered view
Lose the view column collation during declaration
Allow a view as a mutation target

evidence.P01: Explicit relation kind and absolute identity together with corresponding typed field slots.
evidence.P02: Source and mutation destination placement enforced by their owning values.
evidence.P03: Immutable external reference values with only consumed field metadata.
evidence.P04: Relational composition driven by the selected declared source and its slot reads.
evidence.P05: A closed kind and checked owned headings and native field descriptors.
evidence.P06: Qualified SQL rendering preserving actual external rows and native field types.
evidence.Q01: Check admitted and forbidden kind and role placement at construction and lowering.
evidence.Q02: Exhaust the direct fixture product and native analyzed input statements on each pin.
evidence.Q03: Compare an independent model of the filter and joined row multiplicities.
evidence.Q04: Check native rows, result labels, types and retained text collation against independent expectations.
evidence.Q05: Connect typed kind, catalog metadata, construction and renderer to the actual split PHP.

open: View DDL and updatable-view effects as complete IR
Arbitrary expression collation, further character types and functions, access-control behavior and other server modes
trust: Truthful external declarations and the native view algorithm
Explicitly resolved native field types and collations
Independent row and metadata oracle and exact distributed source bytes
